Specs

Measuring 39″ wide and 12″ tall, the GenStone faux wood panel features a 1″ shiplap edge along the top and right side of the panel making attaching the next panel not only seamless but also watertight. Each panel is cast from reclaimed barnwood to ensure authentic texture and hand stained to eliminate repetition.
